definitions.explanation: A surface of ground that is not flat, especially one that goes up or down.

examples.japanese: {坂|さか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}って→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I go up the hill to school.
If you go down the slope, there's a station.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{辺|あた}り→辺り：01770_atari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{坂|さか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{自転車|じてんしゃ}→自転車：00633_jitensha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: There are many hills in this area, so it's tough by bicycle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎朝|まいあさ}→毎朝：00966_maiasa⟧⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{長|なが}い→長い：00491_nagai⟧{坂|さか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}って→登る：00660_noboru⟧⟦{会社|かいしゃ}→会社：00607_kaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}く→行く：00119_iku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧⟦けど→けど：09477_kedo⟧、⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{思|おも}う→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: It's tough to go up this long hill every morning to get to work, but I think it's good for my health.

notes:
{坂|さか} refers to a sloping street or hillside path.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {坂|さか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{上|のぼ}る→登る：00660_noboru⟧: to go up a hill
- {坂|さか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|くだ}る→下る：03913_kudaru⟧/⟦{下|お}りる→降りる：00568_oriru⟧: to go down a hill
- ⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧な{坂|さか}: steep slope
- ⟦{坂道|さかみち}→坂道：08166_sakamichi⟧: sloping road, hill road

IN PLACE NAMES:
{坂|さか} appears in many famous Japanese place names:
- {赤坂|あかさか}: Akasaka (Tokyo)
- {道玄坂|どうげんざか}: Dogenzaka (Shibuya)
- {乃木坂|のぎざか}: Nogizaka

- ⟦{丘|おか}→丘：02183_oka⟧: hill (landform)
- ⟦{斜面|しゃめん}→斜面：12870_shamen⟧: slope (general term)
